label: Bible Study
prompt: And as he lay and slept under a _____ tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.
verse: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.
note: Burned-out Elijah's first prescription from heaven: a nap, a snack, and a gentle angelic nudge.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by _____.
verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.
note: Moses asks for God's presence; God answers: thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and _____, and peacocks.
verse: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
note: Solomon's ships brought home gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks — every three years, like clockwork.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the _____ of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.
verse: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.
note: Daniel's throne-room vision: the Ancient of days in white, his throne blazing like fire.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For I _____ not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
verse: For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
note: Paul arrived in Corinth 'determined' to know nothing among them but Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
